brand.name: Easy Pay Direct
brand.description: Payment processing infrastructure for over 100,000 merchants across 13+ years.

assets.__motif_note__: EPD has TWO valid motif families. Both are canonical. Pick the one that matches the layout. If unsure, hero-family for hero graphics and central/vertical compositions; side-family for section edges, wide banners, and social crops that need a framed feel.

motif_hero_on_navy.description: Concentric rounded-diamond outlines fading up from the bottom of a deep navy background. This is the homepage-hero motif family. Use for hero graphics, vertical compositions, and any layout where the motif reads as an anchor rising from the bottom.
recommended_for: 9:16 social where copy sits above the motif

motif_hero_on_light.description: Hero motif on a light neutral background. Very subtle overlay.

motif_hero_tile.description: Hero motif on transparent, high resolution. Use as an overlay layer.

motif_hero_svg.description: Hero motif as SVG. Use in design tools that support vector.

motif_side_on_navy.description: Nested rounded-diamond outlines anchored to the RIGHT edge of a deep navy section. This is the section-edge motif family, used on the site between content sections. Use for wide banners, section backgrounds, and social crops where the motif frames the composition from an edge.
recommended_for: 1:1 social with the motif on one side

motif_side_on_navy_left.description: Side motif mirrored to the LEFT edge of a deep navy section.

motif_side_both_navy.description: Side motif mirrored on BOTH edges of a square (1:1) navy panel. Use for square social crops that want the motif to frame the center.

motif_side_on_light.description: Side motif on the light neutral section background.

motif_side_tile.description: Side motif on transparent, high resolution. Use as an overlay layer.

logo_white.description: Primary horizontal lockup, white version. Use on any dark background.

logo_dark.description: Primary horizontal lockup, navy version. Use on any light background.

palette_swatch.description: Labeled palette image. Attach to any image generation call so the model matches actual EPD colors.

typography_specimen.description: Specimen of General Sans + DM Mono at real display, body, and mono sizes.

example_hero.description: Real easypaydirect.com homepage hero. Attach as a positive style reference for any marketing image on the site or a similar layout.

example_social_graphic.description: Real EPD LinkedIn banner (wide 4:1 style). Attach as a positive style reference for wide social banners.

example_social_square.description: A finished 1:1 EPD ad with the side motif on the right, headline and CTA on the left, dashboard mockup on the right, and three green-check bullet points. Attach as a positive style reference for 1:1 social crops.

motif_dos_and_donts_hero_family.description: Six-panel do/do-not sheet for the HERO motif family. Top row: canonical hero placements (bottom-right, subtle on light, large on cover). Bottom row: hero-motif failure modes (center, full-cover illegible, recolored).

motif_dos_and_donts_side_family.description: Six-panel do/do-not sheet for the SIDE motif family. Top row: canonical side placements (hero, right-edge, both-edge for 1:1). Bottom row: failure modes (invented shape, high opacity, recolored).
